Method of Attack: Command injection vulnerability due to unsafe evaluation of environment variables and shell expansions
Exploitation through maliciously crafted .desktop and .directory files
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions using KDE Plasma (e.g., Manjaro, openSUSE, Kubuntu, PCLinuxOS)
Attack Vector: Downloading and viewing malicious .desktop or .directory files in a file manager
Dragging and dropping a link of a malicious file into documents or desktop
